detector.description: Alerts when k8s job has pods in failed phase for more than 80% of time in last 5 min
detector.name: K8s job with pod failed (%) > 90
detector.programText:
A = data('k8s.job.failed_pods', rollup='latest').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.namespace.name', 'k8s.job.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
AE = data('k8s.job.successful_pods', rollup='latest').sum(by=['k8s.cluster.name', 'k8s.namespace.name', 'k8s.job.name']).publish(label='AE', enable=False)
AF = ((A/(A+AE))*100).publish(label='AF')
detect(when(A > threshold(90)), auto_resolve_after='15d').publish('K8s job with pod failed (%) > 90')

rules.description: The value of k8s.job.failed_pods - Sum by k8s.cluster.name,k8s.namespace.name,k8s.job.name is above 90.
